button.$description: Severity (meaning) × variant (emphasis: filled · outlined · text · link) × size.

badge.$description: Same severity model as Button; variants soft · solid · outlined.

label-max-width.$description: Max width of a step label in horizontal Steps

alert.$description: Uses badge-like tone per severity: soft = intent.soft + intent.border, outlined = surface + 400 border, solid = intent.solid.

input-min-width.$description: Minimum width of the text field that follows the chips

sparkline.$description: Inline trend line used inside metric cards and tables.

metric-card.$description: KPI card: label, value, delta and trend. Variants: default, compact, hero, goal, breakdown, comparison.

data-table.$description: Sortable, selectable table that becomes a card list below the md breakpoint.

chart.$description: Frame shared by every chart: surface, padding and the colour of text, grid and series.

calendar.$description: Month grid for DatePicker and DateRangePicker. Day cells are 40px, above the 24px minimum of WCAG 2.2 target size.

date-picker.$description: Trigger button and floating panel of DatePicker and DateRangePicker.

spinner.$description: Indeterminate progress indicator. The arc must reach 3:1 against the surface (WCAG 1.4.11).

empty-state.$description: Placeholder for a region with nothing to show yet: icon, title, short reason and one action.

meter.$description: Single measurement against a known maximum (role=meter). Severity changes the colour and the spoken status.
